finalText:
Build's clean — exit 0, 0 errors. Found two real bugs from the bump (both in the link stage, everything else was deprecation-warning noise):

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but the code still read `options.retries` (now `undefined`), crashing on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` had no case for `undefined` and threw. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled).

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc.) from the dependency bump — not build-breaking, so I left those alone.
